proposal.description: The latch test is moved out of the hiccup-entry branch to a later point in the cool-down. It compares the count after it has landed with MAX_STRIKES while hiccup_active is high, instead of testing the count about to land on the entry clock.
proposal.reason: On the hiccup that reaches MAX_STRIKES, latch_assert rises one clock late, so the supervisor stays in S_HICCUP one clock longer before it goes to S_OFF. Also, if the host lowers max_strikes to or below the current count during a cool-down, the latch trips in the middle of that cool-down instead of waiting for the next hiccup entry.
